name: LGPT
description: Little Piggy Tracker (formerly LittleGPTracker) for TrimUI handhelds. A sample-based music tracker built for a d-pad, not a keyboard: the song / chain / phrase / instrument / table workflow of LSDj, which the Dirtywave M8 later took up. Eight channels, 128 chains, 128 phrases, sample and MIDI instruments, live play modes and real-time FX commands. Runs on Brick, Brick Pro, Smart Pro and tg5050 - the pak ships a binary for each platform and picks the right one at launch. Projects and the sample library live in /mnt/SDCARD/LGPT so they survive pak updates.
author: Marc Nostromo (original), djdiskmachine (fork), tg5040 port
features: Tracker workflow: song > chain > phrase > instrument > table, driven entirely from the d-pad
Sample instruments with filters, modulation tables and real-time FX commands
Live play modes: song, chain, phrase and live-queue triggering
Crisp 3x integer scaling, no blur: 960x720 centred on a 1024x768 Brick, full height on a 1280x720 device
One pak for every supported device - separate tg5040 and tg5050 binaries, selected automatically at launch
Projects and samplelib stored in /mnt/SDCARD/LGPT, outside the pak, so Pak Store updates never touch your songs
CPU governor pinned to performance and sleep inhibited while running, restored on exit
